title: palicourea spadicea
intro: Palicourea spadicea, commonly known as 'Santa Maria', is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest and other tropical regions. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Palicourea spadicea include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
